title: paged KV cache: block allocator reuse and locality-aware pinning refactor
author: Daniel Cho
description: Refactor the paged KV cache block manager to improve allocator reuse, introduce locality-aware pinning, and reduce fragmentation. Motivation: production canary runs showed increased GC-like churn in the KV cache when working set shifts across conversations, leading to extra GPU memory copies and higher tail latency for long-lived sessions. This PR reorganizes the BlockAllocator to separate lifetime management from placement policy, adds a reusable free-list with per-size buckets, and implements locality hints so we prefer reusing blocks that are already resident on the same GPU/NUMA node. Changes also include stricter pin/unpin semantics, TTL tuning for stale blocks, and a small scheduling heuristic to avoid thrashing under bursty write patterns. Checklist: 1) Unit tests for allocator and pinning semantics added, 2) Integration load test with synthetic bursty workload updated, 3) Canary job in perf-lab executed and profiling attached, 4) Documentation of config knobs and rollout notes. Impact: observed ~12% lower 99th percentile token latency in canary, ~18% reduction in cross-device memcpy during steady-state, and ~9% lower memory fragmentation in simulated multi-tenant workloads. Linked work: ENG-1423, ENG-1487. Rolling upgrade notes: allocator state is backward compatible but TTL/pinning params should be tuned during rollout for clusters with very small working sets.
commits: Refactor BlockAllocator into allocator/{allocator,placement}.cpp and add unit tests
Implement per-size free lists and reuse paths to avoid repeated device allocations
Add locality-aware pinning: prefer blocks on same device/NUMA node
Expose allocator TTL and bucket sizing via runtime config and console metrics
Fix race in unpin path and add defensive checks to avoid double-free under contention
Perf test: add kv_cache_allocator_stress and update canary job config
review_comments: Asha: Overall looks good and the perf numbers are compelling. Please add a brief note on how this interacts with existing KV cache eviction; are we changing eviction ordering?
Author(Daniel): We preserved eviction ordering. Pinning only biases reuse; eviction still consults LRU at the page level. Added comment in paged_kv_cache.cpp to clarify.
Miguel: Concern about the unpin race under heavy concurrency — the defensive checks are good but can we add a stress test that runs with many concurrent pins/unpins?
Author: Added allocator stress test and extended canary to run with concurrent session churn for 30m. Observed no double-free and stable metrics.
Priya: Small nit on config naming - renamed 'allocator_bucket_size' to 'allocator_bucket_count' for clarity per console config conventions.
Asha: Approved after addressing the above and adding rollout notes.
release_notes: Improve KV cache block allocator reuse and add locality-aware pinning to reduce cross-device copies and tail latency. Configurable TTL and bucket sizing exposed for tuning.
